payload.body:
[[Alternate costume]]s of official origin, whether it be from the creators themselves, or from second-parties involved in the given copyright. Generally a costume other than the standard one the character appears in.

These can often times appear in manga/anime (beach episodes, as one example), video games (whether as unlockables or as skins to be bought in gacha games), and on special events. Figures which can have such costumes include [[Virtual YouTuber]]s.

[b]Only[/b] use this tag for official costumes of the wearer themselves. If the character is wearing an official costume belonging to another character, use [[alternate costume]] or [[cosplay]] instead as applicable.

[b]Do not[/b] use this tag with [[alternate costume]], the tags are mutually exclusive.

h4. Examples

* !post #9729220

h4. See also

* [[official alternate hairstyle]]
** [[official alternate hair length]]
payload.title: official_alternate_costume

payload.body:
A character with [[rabbit]]-like ears, such as a [[rabbit girl]] or a [[Playboy bunny]].

If the character does not usually have rabbit ears, add [[kemonomimi mode]]. If the ears are real, add [[rabbit girl]] or [[rabbit boy]] accordingly. If the ears are fake, like the kind worn by [[Playboy bunny|Playboy bunnies]], add [[fake animal ears]].

For characters that are using their hands to form rabbit ears, see [[rabbit pose]]; for characters creating 'rabbit ears' behind another character, see [[bunny ears prank]].

h4. Examples

* !post #5999997
* !post #6032984
* !post #9079385: [[Lop rabbit ears]]
* !post #5665419: [[Fake animal ears]]

h4. See also

* [[Lop rabbit ears]]
* [[animal ears]]
* [[rabbit tail]]
* [[fake animal ears]] 
** [[rabbit ear hairband]] 
** [[rabbit ear headphones]]
** [[rabbit hood]]
payload.title: rabbit_ears
